title: Pacta RPC-pinned control-plane records
description: Read-only control-plane observations of 4 protocols (0 Ethereum, 4 Base), each pinned to a canonical block number and block hash and reproducible with cast. These records are NOT EAS-attested: they have no sprint number, no summary document and no Base EAS UID. The Base-EAS-attested Sprint records are in /api/v1/index.json. Euler V2 (EVK) and Moonwell Lending (Base) were re-scanned in Sprint 18, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Pendle Finance V2 and Rocket Pool (rETH) were re-scanned in Sprint 19, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Frax Ether (frxETH / sfrxETH) and Puffer Finance (pufETH) were re-scanned in Sprint 20, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Aerodrome Finance (Base) and Balancer V2 Vault & TimelockAuthorizer were re-scanned in Sprint 21, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Across Protocol (HubPool) and Beefy Finance (Base) were re-scanned in Sprint 22, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Uniswap V3 & Governance Timelock and Reserve Protocol (eUSD RToken) were re-scanned in Sprint 23, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Synthetix V3 Core and Centrifuge V3 Root (Base) were re-scanned in Sprint 24, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here. Bedrock (uniETH) and Safe Smart Account (v1.4.1 Singleton) were re-scanned in Sprint 25, compared against their documentation and moved to the Base-EAS-attested index (same /protocols/ slugs); they are no longer RPC-pinned records here.

attestation.note: No on-chain attestation exists for these records yet; any future attestation will be added here with its UID.

verification: Captured by one Pacta seat over public JSON-RPC and independently re-read at the same pinned blocks by a second seat (block hash, runtime bytecode size and keccak256, EIP-1967 implementation / admin slots, controller getter, Safe getThreshold / getOwners, timelock delay). Two records were corrected by the re-read (Moonwell admin contract, Uniswap V3 factory owner contract).
